messages:
Marta (Support): FYI getting a spike of customer tickets for 502/504s from hosted API in us-west-2 — started ~10:12 UTC. Major customers report timeouts and some 5xx. Opening war room now.
Priya (SRE): I'm on it, joining. Can someone grab service metrics and recent deploys? :eyes:
Alex S.: I see elevated 502/504 rates in the gateway for model-serving routes: /v1/generate and /v1/chat. P95 latency jumped from 120ms to >2s for a subset.
InfraBot: Alert: gateway-hosted-prod us-west-2 error_rate > 5% for 10m. Triggered at 2026-03-15T10:14:22Z.
Sam (Eng-runtime): No new model pushes in the last 3 hours. There was a config rollout for autoscaler scalingPolicy v2 at 09:58 UTC (canary).
Jordan (Prod): Can we pin to fallback variant until we know root cause? Some customers are on heavy-context models.
Marta (Support): Customers A and B reported 504s and have active sessions — I've asked them to switch to smaller model as workaround, but need infra changes for broad mitigation.
Priya (SRE): Quick checks: K8s node CPU/memory OK, no mass OOMs. Gateway logs show upstream reset/timeout for backend pods. I'm running a grep of recent 502 stack traces.
Alex S.: Pasted sample gateway errors (trimmed):
```
[2026-03-15T10:13:40Z] upstream response timeout for connection to runtime-pool-5; code=504
[2026-03-15T10:13:41Z] upstream reset by peer during body read; code=502
```
Sam (Eng-runtime): That aligns with KV cache eviction behavior we pushed in scalingPolicy v2 — when pod scale-down is aggressive we observed stale connection churn. Might be connection pooling bug with new policy.
Priya (SRE): For immediate mitigation, I'm going to disable the canary autoscaler policy in us-west-2 and roll back to autoscaler v1.
Jordan (Prod): +1. Also enable routing fallback to us-west-1 for new requests while rollback proceeds.
InfraBot: Executing playbook: rollback-autoscaler-policy to v1 in region us-west-2 (initiated).
Marta (Support): Notifying customers: "We're investigating, mitigation in progress; recommended: retry or reduce context size. We'll update"
Alex S.: Rolling restart of runtime-pool-5 to cut stale connections? That might be faster than waiting for autoscaler rollback.
Priya (SRE): Doing staged restart of runtime-pool-5 pod set now (one at a time).
Sam (Eng-runtime): I'm toggling connection keepalive on gateway to force re-dial while we fix.
Marta (Support): Customers report decreased error rate after ~4 minutes. Some still seeing intermittent 502s.
Priya (SRE): Autoscaler rollback complete at 10:23 UTC. Error rate dropped from 6.3% to 0.8% in 5m window. P95 latency improving.
Jordan (Prod): Good. Keep global routing open but don't shift more than 20% traffic to other regions — we want to observe.
Alex S.: Post-mitigation snapshot:
- Error spikes correspond to scale-down windows where backend pod connection count was forcibly closed.
- Gateway didn't retry enough on idempotent internal calls.

Sam (Eng-runtime): Root cause hypothesis: autoscaler v2 reduced steady-state pod count and aggressively reaped pods which had active KV cache/long-lived gRPC streams. New connection pooling behavior caused upstream resets on in-flight requests (504/502).
Priya (SRE): Agreed. Evidence: logs show close_to_idle events followed by connection reset within seconds. Also observed increased connection churn in sidecar metrics.
Marta (Support): Actionable customer communications needed: postmortem + timeline + temporary measures.
Jordan (Prod): We should also add a protective rate-limit for largest customers during rollout and a health check gate for autoscaler changes.
Alex S.: Immediate action items (we did some already):
- Roll back autoscaler policy in us-west-2 (done)
- Staged restart of affected runtime pool (done)
- Enabled cross-region fallback (partial)
- Notified customers (in progress)

Sam (Eng-runtime): Longer term engineering tasks:
- Revert aggressive scale-down behavior in autoscaler v2 and add pod-drain graceful window for runtime pods (make it configurable)
- Fix connection pooling to detect and re-establish broken upstreams without surfacing 5xx to clients
- Add integration test that simulates rapid scale-down with active KV cache/gRPC streams
- Add canary gating: require 24h of synthetic load stability before global rollout

Priya (SRE): Operational tasks:
- Add alert for connection churn (sidecar_conn_recycles > threshold)
- Update runbook to include fast rollback steps for autoscaler changes
- Make fallback routing an automated step in playbooks for region degradation

Marta (Support): Customer-facing tasks:
- Send interim update to impacted customers summarizing mitigation and ETA for root cause analysis (1hr)
- Prepare postmortem draft by EOD and schedule a customer sync for tomorrow (if they want)

Jordan (Prod): Risk/approval items: apply hold on autoscaler v2 rollout until eng fixes shipped and canary monitored. I'll create a policy ticket.
Alex S.: Quick repro notes for postmortem: steps I used to reproduce in staging:
1) Deploy autoscaler v2 with aggressive scale-down settings
2) Start long-lived chat sessions with ~100 open KV-cached contexts per pod
3) Trigger scale-down by dropping QPS via test harness; observe connection resets and gateway 502/504

Sam (Eng-runtime): I'll attach the failing logs and a minimal repro harness to the PR.
Priya (SRE): Postmortem owners: Sam (root cause, fix) + Priya (runbook/alerts) + Jordan (release gating) + Marta (customer comms). Target: interim RCA within 24 hours, full postmortem in 72 hours.
Marta (Support): Assigning follow-ups in tracker now. Drafting customer note.
InfraBot: Post-incident tasks created: TASK-4321 (autoscaler rollback review), TASK-4322 (connection-pool fix), TASK-4323 (synthetic canary), TASK-4324 (customer comms).
Alex S.: Anything else before we wrap? We should also consider adding apm traces to link gateway->runtime RPCs for faster triage.
Priya (SRE): Good call. Add to postmortem action items. For now monitoring shows stability for 18m, I'll close war room in 30m unless we see regression.
Marta (Support): Thanks everyone. I'll update the channel with the interim customer note and link to tasks.
Jordan (Prod): Closing note: limit autoscaler v2 rollouts until fixes. All hands thanks. :team_parrot:
